Before you, a merchant wagon lies splintered on its side, its draft oxen slaughtered in their traces by heavy, barbed crossbow bolts. Iron-shackled raiders step from the gloom of the Blighted Reach, blades drawn and teeth bared, circling the wreckage with ruthless purpose. Their scarred leader halts in mid-stride, lowering his notched broadsword as his cold eyes lock onto your face with a vicious grin of sudden recognition.
